title: Viator Tours and Activities Tracker Input

destinationUrls.title: Destination URLs
destinationUrls.description: Full Viator destination URLs. Example: https://www.viator.com/Paris/d479-ttd, https://www.viator.com/London/d737-ttd. Find the URL for any city by browsing viator.com.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keyword searches like "cooking class paris", "sunset cruise dubai", "vatican skip the line". Uses Viator's own search.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: Direct Viator product page URLs to pull. Use when you want exact listings (price history, reviews on a specific tour).

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Drop tours with a rating below this (out of 5). 4.5 is the sweet spot for top picks.

minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count
minReviewCount.description: Drop tours with fewer than this many reviews. 50 filters out brand new listings. 500+ only returns best sellers.

maxPriceUsd.title: Maximum price ($)
maxPriceUsd.description: Drop tours priced above this. Use with minPriceUsd for price brackets.

minPriceUsd.title: Minimum price ($)
minPriceUsd.description: Drop tours priced below this. Useful to exclude free city walks when searching premium experiences.

languageCode.title: Language code
languageCode.description: Viator language code. en = English, es = Spanish, fr = French, de = German, it = Italian, pt = Portuguese, ja = Japanese, zh = Chinese.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per destination or per query cap on rows pushed. Each destination page typically has 30 to 50 featured tours.

maxItemsTotal.title: Maximum items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows pushed to the dataset per run. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip product codes pushed on previous runs. Stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS. Turn off to track price changes over time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential group recommended if you run every few minutes or hit rate limits.
